title: Crate
description: Inventory manager with live stock metrics, instant search, and quick restocking.

techDetails.scope: Transitioned from Java to Python backend engineering—applying FastAPI validation, PostgreSQL relational modeling, and centralized database session lifecycles hands-on.
highlights: REST API with Pydantic v2 schema validation and interactive Swagger UI docs
SQLAlchemy ORM data modeling in PostgreSQL with a centralized get_db session dependency, safe teardown, and startup auto-seeding
React dashboard with live inventory metrics, instant search, status filtering, and one-click restocking

title: SpringMart
description: Product catalog with multi-field search, pagination, and direct image streaming.

techDetails.scope: Built to design and containerize a full-stack Java application from scratch using Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, and Docker.
techDetails.architecture: Java • Spring Boot • Spring Data JPA • H2 • Docker • React
highlights: REST API with custom JPQL multi-field search, pagination, and startup auto-seeding in H2
Multipart product CRUD with validation and direct raw-byte image streaming from the database
Dockerized backend deployed on Render connected to a React client on Netlify

title: Student Management System
description: Console app for student records, flexible search, and SQL analytics.

techDetails.scope: My first coding project—built to learn Java and MySQL, separating business logic from database operations with JDBC from scratch.
highlights: Layered architecture separating console menus, business logic, and database operations
Parameterized JDBC queries using PreparedStatements to prevent SQL injection across all operations
SQL analytics queries calculating grade distributions, summary stats, and ranked top performers

title: wrkout
description: Minimal PPL workout tracker for progressive overload.

techDetails.scope: Built when I first joined the gym dealing with Class 1 obesity at 94 kg (207 lbs). Designed around a Push-Pull-Legs split to track progressive overload, and used daily to lose 30 kg (66 lbs) in 1 year.
highlights: Fast set logging with inline steppers, one-tap saving, and audio/haptic feedback
Progressive overload tracking with automatic volume calculations and workout comparisons
Supabase Auth and PostgreSQL with Row Level Security (RLS)

title: Shreyan's Arc
description: Interactive DSA roadmap and progress tracker with 37 curated problems across 8 core patterns.

techDetails.scope: Built to cut out duplicate LeetCode grind—distilling 37 high-yield problems across 8 core patterns into an interactive canvas.
highlights: Interactive pan-and-zoom canvas to explore connected algorithmic patterns
Local storage persistence with optional Google Auth and Cloud Firestore multi-device sync
37 high-yield problems with direct practice links to LeetCode

title: J-Void
description: Distraction-free in-browser Java editor for practicing coding interview patterns.

techDetails.scope: Built without LeetCode's UI clutter to write and review clean Java solutions alongside Shreyan's Arc.
highlights: Monaco code editor with custom warm themes, syntax highlighting, and Allman brace formatting
Interactive gutter bookmarks pinned to line numbers that stay synced during edits
37 curated problems paired directly with the Shreyan's Arc roadmap

title: WealthWise
description: Financial advisory platform with goal-based calculators, bilingual FAQs, and direct WhatsApp inquiries.

techDetails.scope: Built for my father's advisory practice so clients can explore services and calculate financial goals before initial consultations.
highlights: Goal-based planning calculators for SIP, retirement, and education verified with Jest unit tests
Direct WhatsApp routing with pre-filled consultation requests and calculator projections
Bilingual FAQ in English and Bengali alongside service guides for mutual funds and insurance
